input.quote: (vi) Transition Assistance. With regard to Termination Products in countries for which the licenses to Sanofi are terminating, Sanofi shall provide the following transitional assistance, with costs allocated as set forth below:
input.rationale: Article XII's exit machinery runs one way: Section 12.3(c)(vi) and 12.3(c)(iv)/(v) oblige Sanofi to provide transition assistance and transfer regulatory materials, data, marks and inventory to RevMed. Nothing obliges RevMed to give Sanofi transition assistance or to export Sanofi's data on expiry or termination generally; Section 12.3(e) (p0531) is limited to one Change-of-Control scenario, and Section 11.6 only provides for destruction of Confidential Information on request, not return/export within a fixed period. The rule therefore fails the fallback on every element, so we insert the shortest reciprocal clause at the fallback level (90 days' assistance; export within 30 days of expiry or termination) rather than the preferred six-month/machine-readable/certified-deletion package.

ops.text: (f) Transition Assistance to Sanofi. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, RevMed shall, at Sanofi's request, provide Sanofi with reasonable transition assistance for a period of at least ninety (90) days following such expiration or termination, and shall, within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, export and deliver to Sanofi all data and materials of Sanofi then in RevMed's possession or control.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a reciprocal exit provision so that, on any expiry or termination, RevMed gives us at least 90 days of transition assistance and exports our data within 30 days; Article XII currently imposes transition and data-transfer duties only on Sanofi.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 12.3(f) requiring RevMed to provide 90 days of transition assistance and export Sanofi data within 30 days of expiry or termination.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
